prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.0 °C (64% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.7 °C (48% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.0 °C (56% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.81 s (within 1% of healthy). Minor delay in pressure rise and slight inter-sensor switching lag indicate beginning valve actuation lag.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 1314 W·min/l (243% above healthy); FS1 mean volume flow 2.08 l/min (68% below healthy); SE system efficiency factor 19.6 % (67% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 59.0 bar (26% above healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.
